 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 35 mins 35 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Ten minutes to go until the break as Manchester City resume their quest for an equaliser.
 Can they find one before the break?
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:06 BST 13:06 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Very intense atmosphere here in Villa Park even with one stand missing. 
 57 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 34 mins 34 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Johan Manzambi goes for goal but finds the stand.
 63 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's just clumsy from Guehi' published at 13:05 BST 13:05 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Marc Guehi has struggled to contain Nicolas Jackson, it's just clumsy isn't it. 
 Jackson gets the first touch and then they just come together.
 Man City are struggling with that little ball and are leaving too much space. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 108 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 34 mins 34 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Johan Manzambi and John McGinn stand over the free-kick after Manchester City's players were being awkward about getting out of the way.
 A five-man wall and a draft excluder for City.
 25 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:04 BST 13:04 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Manzambi is what a 120m midfielder should play like. Running absolute rings around Fernandez and Anderson.
 Peter 
 214 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Marc Guehi goes into the referee's book for a foul on Nicolas Jackson, who was wriggling free and charging down on goal.
 Villa have a free-kick in a dangerous spot.
 162 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 32 mins 32 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Manchester City claiming for a penalty as Ian Maatsen challenges Iliman Ndiaye close to the byline.
 Again, the VAR has a look but no penalty.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 171 94 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 30 mins 30 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Johan Manzambi gets himself forward and Elliot Anderson stands strong to block the player.
 Aston Villa claiming for a foul but the referee says no.
 100 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Ndiaye's lively on this right hand side' published at 13:01 BST 13:01 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT Sports 
 Iliman Ndiaye's lively on this right hand side for City. 
 He finds a bit of space and gets the shot in early, that could have snuck in past Zion Suzuki who had gone early. 
 68 65 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 28 mins 28 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Manchester City are getting closer.
 Iliman Ndiaye bends one towards the bottom far corner but it pings off the post.
 176 156 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Manzambi has got everything' published at 12:59 BST 12:59 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Owen Hargreaves 
Former Manchester United midfielder on TNT Sports 
 He's the real deal isn't he Johan Manzambi, in and out of possession. He's got everything. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 242 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 12:58 BST 12:58 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Just imagine what Unai would have done with Arsenal if he was given seven years, a billion pounds, and allowances for poor periods of form. I for one am a very pleased Villa fan. We have the best manager in the league by far.
 Dan 
 845 441 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 25 mins 25 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Another save from the very busy Zion Suzuki.
 This time from unlikely source Abdukodir Khusanov. A low, drilled effort saved down to his right.
 203 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Suzuki has been created in a lab' published at 12:55 BST 12:55 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Owen Hargreaves 
Former Manchester United midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Zion Suzuki has been created in a lab, he's a great goalkeeper, great size and great feet. 
 He's a good shot stopper. His distribution too, long or short. 
 415 64 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 24 mins 24 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Manchester City grinding through the gears here but Aston Villa have defended well and have Zion Suzuki to thank, too.
 A spell of pressure ends Ruben Dias dinking the ball into the box for Erling Haaland but the big hands of the goalkeeper get there first.
 124 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Nice, pacey play from Manchester City as Jeremy Doku wriggles free down the left-hand side then cuts it back for Rayan Cherki.
 The Frenchman fires his shot off but it's another good save from Zion Suzuki to keep Villa ahead.
 180 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 12:51 BST 12:51 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 With Emery as manager it isn't out of the realms of possibility that Villa could win the league in the next few seasons... so long as this (ahem) fair play nonsense is sorted.
 Paul 
 587 379 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20 mins 20 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Manchester City are appealing for a penalty after a shove on Enzo Fernandez from Joao Gomez and the VAR does have a quick look but sees nothing in it.
 Aston Villa get on the break and Nicolas Jackson has a shot but drags it wide.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 146 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Villa's passing has been exceptional' published at 12:49 BST 12:49 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Man City 
 Owen Hargreaves 
Former Manchester United midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Aston Villa press well but the passing with the ball has been exceptional, they're man to man with the ball. 
 Under Unai Emery, Villa are so good tactically. They're protecting the pitch and leaving space out wide, they seem so well drilled.
